entries.source: You must have a free hand to divide the %s.
entries.target: 你必须空出一只手才能分裂 %s。

entries.source: You cannot split your %s while it has a tinker inside.
entries.target: 你不能分裂%s，因为目前有配件附着在上面。

entries.source: You cannot split your %s while using it as a psionic focus.
entries.target: 你不能分裂%s，你正用其作为灵能聚焦。

entries.source: Your %s is too flawed to divide.
You divide your %s in two, forming a linked set.
entries.target: 你分裂了%s，使其组成套装。

entries.source: This mindstar would symbiotize with another like it.
entries.target: 这件灵晶会与另一件同样的灵晶共生。

entries.source: #SLATE#The link between the mindstars is broken.
Deals #YELLOW#%d#LAST# Manaburn damage and puts 1 random spell talent on cooldown for #YELLOW#%d#LAST# turns (checks Confusion immunity)
entries.target: 造成#YELLOW#%d#LAST#法力燃烧伤害，并将1个随机法术技能置入冷却#YELLOW#%d#LAST#回合（须通过混乱免疫）

entries.source: #YELLOW#%s has their %s spell disrupted for for %d turns!
Cause the target to have a 10%% chance to fail spellcasting and 10%% chance to lose a magical sustain each turn, stacking up to 50%%
entries.target: 使目标施放法术时有10%%几率失败，并且每回合有10%%几率失去一项魔法持续技能，最高叠加到50%%
